payload.objective: Build a general reliable software installation pipeline covering shared artifact publication, conflict-aware scheduling, transactional recovery, and failed-item retry.
boundaries: Local code, focused tests, and local phase commits only. Do not push or release.
Validation is limited to crash evidence and one concrete result of the active change. No full suites or unrelated regression runs.
Do not hide faults by disabling concurrency or adding software/device special cases.

payload.title: Atomic shared artifact publication
payload.objective: Publish one complete immutable shared artifact for concurrent requests using isolated attempt staging.
acceptance: Concurrent requests all succeed and observe one complete final artifact.
Debug cold start shows no crash evidence.
invariants: Do not reduce global concurrency to one or special-case Git, curl, or a device.
payload.nextAction: Extract a shared artifact publisher and replace both fixed pending publication sites.

payload.title: Conflict-aware write scheduling
payload.objective: Schedule resource work by declared write scopes and reject duplicate resource mutation.
acceptance: Independent resources can run concurrently while conflicting writes never overlap.
Debug cold start shows no crash evidence.

payload.title: Install transaction and interruption recovery
payload.objective: Wire candidate install, verification, commit, rollback, and restart recovery into the real resource run path.
acceptance: An interrupted install preserves the previous usable version and is settled on next startup.
Debug cold start shows no crash evidence.
invariants: Do not duplicate durable state ownership.
payload.nextAction: Align ResourceTransactionCoordinator with the production gateway contract.
